privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Body: ft_transcendence is a student project developed as part of the 42 curriculum. This service is provided for educational purposes and is not a commercial platform. This policy explains what data we collect, why we collect it, and how we use it.
privacy.s2Item1: : the email address, username, and hashed password you provide at registration.
privacy.s2Item2: : session tokens stored in a secure cookie to keep you logged in. Tokens are stored hashed on our server.
privacy.s2Item3: : match history, scores, and game statistics required for the product's core features (leaderboards, profile).
privacy.s2Item4: : minimal server logs (IP address, timestamps, user-agent) used to debug and protect against abuse.
privacy.s3Body: We use the data strictly to operate the service: authenticating you, displaying your profile, matching you with opponents, and maintaining service security. We do not sell your data and we do not use it for advertising.
privacy.s4Body: Your password is never stored in clear text. We hash it with argon2id, an industry standard algorithm. Data is stored in a PostgreSQL database accessible only to the application. Traffic between your browser and our servers is encrypted using HTTPS.
privacy.s5Body: Under the GDPR, you can request access to the personal data we hold about you, request its correction, and ask for its deletion. To exercise these rights, contact the project owners. Deleting your account removes your profile data and invalidates all active sessions.
privacy.s6Body: We use a single essential cookie (session_token) to maintain your authenticated session. This cookie is HTTP-only, secure, and SameSite=strict. We do not use analytics, advertising, or third-party tracking cookies.
privacy.s7Body: As this is an evolving student project, this policy may be updated. We will update the "Last updated" date when changes are made.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1Body: By creating an account or using ft_transcendence, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use the service.
terms.s2Body: ft_transcendence is a non-commercial student project. The service is provided "as is" for educational and recreational use. Availability, features, and data are not guaranteed, and the service may be interrupted, reset, or discontinued at any time without notice.
terms.s3Item1: You must provide accurate information when registering.
terms.s3Item2: You are responsible for keeping your password secure.
terms.s3Item3: You must not share your account or use someone else's account.
terms.s3Item4: One person = one account. Creating multiple accounts to disrupt gameplay is prohibited.
terms.s4Item1: Exploit bugs, cheat, use bots, or otherwise unfairly gain an advantage.
terms.s4Item2: Harass, threaten, or send abusive content to other users.
terms.s4Item3: Attempt to disrupt, overload, or attack the service.
terms.s4Item4: Upload content that infringes copyrights or violates applicable laws.
terms.s4Item5: Attempt to bypass security or authentication mechanisms.
terms.s4Outro: We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these rules.
terms.s5Body: You remain the owner of content you create (usernames, messages, etc.) but you grant us a license to display and store it as needed to operate the service. You are responsible for the content you publish.
terms.s6Body: The service is provided without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee that the service will be uninterrupted, error-free, or free from security vulnerabilities.
terms.s7Body: We may update these terms as the project evolves. Continued use of the service after changes means you accept the updated terms.
terms.s8Body: For questions about these terms, contact the project owners via the project repository.
